# Jobs, Realtime and Caching

Run background jobs and scheduled tasks, push realtime events and cache data.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Background Jobs](background-jobs.md) | Run code outside the web request with frappe.enqueue and enqueue_doc, on RQ queues served by bench workers. |
| [Scheduler](scheduler.md) | Run functions on a schedule with the scheduler_events hook, Scheduled Job Type records and the bench schedule process. |
| [Realtime](realtime.md) | Push events from the server to browsers with publish_realtime, Socket.IO rooms and frappe.realtime.on, and add custom realtime handlers. |
| [Caching](caching.md) | Cache data in Redis with frappe.cache, read documents with get_cached_doc and get_cached_value, and use the request_cache, site_cache and redis_cache decorators. |
